paite: Pathian inn a na hoh chiang in na khepek kem in; ngaikhe ding a pai, mihaite kithoihna piak sang in ahoihzaw ngal a; gilou ahih uh chih akithei kei uhi.
heading: Thuchiam Bawl Kin Lo Ke’n

paite: Kam lawp ke'nla, Pathian ma a thil himhim gen ding in na lungtang lawptawp kei hen; Pathian lah van ah a-om a, nang lah leitung ah na om ngal a; huaiziak in na thute tawmsak in.
Mang lah thu leh la tampi toh ahong om a; huan mihai aw thu tampi toh.
Pathian kiang a thuchiam na chiam chiang in, pe ding in hal ke'n; mihaite tung ah kipahna anei ngal kei a; na thuchiam pen pia in.
Na chiam a na piak louh sang in, na chiam louh ahoihzaw hi.
Na kam in na sa thil ahihkhelhsak phal ke'n; angel ma ah leng, adik kei chi sam ke'n; bang ding in na aw ah Pathian in aheh in, na khut nasep ahihse dia?
Huchibang in mangte punna leh thute tamna ah bangmah loute a-om nak; himahleh nang zaw Pathian kihta in.
Gentheite hiamgamna in bial sung ah vaihawmna leh diktatna alamang chih na muhleh, huai thu lamdang sa ke'n; thuneitu sangte'n thuneihna neite a-enkai ua; huan amau tung ah asangzaw a-om hi.
heading: Hinna Phattuamna Bei Ahi

paite: Huai lou in lei a punna bang teng a ding ahi; kumpipa ngei leng louma in a-nna asepsak hi.
Kuapeuh dangka deihta dangka in alungkim kei ding; kuapeuh hauh-sakna punna deih taleng; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
Van akibehlap chiang in, amau nete akhang uh; huan huai neimi a ding in bang phattuamna a-om a, amitte a huaite et chih ngal louh?
Ne tawm in ne tam taleh, semgimmi ihmut alim a; himahleh mihausa vahna in amah a-ihmusak kei hi.
Ni nuai a gilou hoih het lou ka muh a-om a, huai tuh, hauhsakna a neipa'n amah siatna ding a akep.
Himahleh huai hauhsaknate thuakna gilou in amangthang hi; tapa asuanleh, akhut ah bangmah a-om kei.
Anu gil a kipan ahong paileh, vuaktang in apai nawn ding a hong pai bang in, asepgimna, akhut a apuakmang theih a ding in bangmah ala kei ding hi.
Huan hiai leng gilou hoih het lou ahi, ahong paidan tengteng in, hichibang in apai ding a; huih a ding a asepgimna ah bang punna anei a?
Adamsung teng in khomial ah an ane a, huan nakpitak a hihbuai in a-om a, chinatna leh thangpaihna anei hi.
Ngai in, hoih leh kilawm hi a ka muh mi'n Pathian in amah apiak adamsung teng a anek a, adawn a, ni nuai a asepgimna tengteng a hoih asakpih a, huai ahi; hiai lah atantuan ahi ngal a.
Mi chiteng leng amah kiang a Pathian in hauhsakna leh neih zohna apiak, huai a nektheihna apiak a, atantuan la ding leh asepgimna a kipak ding in; hiai Pathian thilpiak ahi.
Adam lai nite lah atheigige kei ding a; alungtang kipahna a Pathian in amah adawn ziak in.
